name: How should homeowners prepare their property before log refinishing starts?

mainEntity.name: How should homeowners prepare their property before log refinishing starts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your contractor begins, clear a perimeter around the home to ensure clear work access and prevent accidental damage. Trim back bushes, tree branches, and tall grass at least three to four feet from exterior log walls. Move outdoor furniture, grills, fire pits, and potted plants away from the structure, and cover delicate garden beds near the foundation. Turn off automated sprinkler systems that spray near the logs, and ensure exterior electrical outlets and hose bibbs are operational. Inside, close and latch all windows and secure pets while washing and sanding equipment are in use.
acceptedAnswer.description: Trim vegetation back from exterior walls, move outdoor furniture, shut off nearby lawn sprinklers, and ensure windows are tightly closed before prep and staining begin.
